data.narrative:
Apex Space, founded by Ian Cinnamon and Max Benassi, is a Series D-stage space and aerospace company valued at $2.3B post-money on $718M+ raised. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 5 public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Impulse Space, Varda Space Industries, and others at similar or adjacent stages.

Two methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a standard 1.5x Series D step-up multiplier to the $2.3B last post-money, implies $3.5B. Peer-median anchoring across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B), Impulse Space ($4.3B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B), and Skyryse ($1.1B)—yields a median valuation of $2.9B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applicable; the sector median P/S multiple of 24.4x across six public space companies cannot be deployed without disclosed revenue figures.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $2.5B to $4.0B, with a median of $3.2B. This band reflects moderate upside from the current $2.3B valuation. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations (8x spread from min to max), the nascent and heterogeneous nature of the space sector, and the absence of revenue data to calibrate multiples-based approaches.
